game: Tidekeeper — a cozy 2D side-scrolling platformer. Miso, a small orange cat in a yellow raincoat, keeps the old lighthouse lit on a stormy island: she hops across rocks and piers, collects glowing lantern oil, dodges grumpy crabs, and relights the lamp so the fishing boats get home.
style: 16-bit pixel art in the style of a modern indie platformer (crisp pixels, no anti-aliasing, limited 32-colour palette of deep sea blues, teal, warm lamp orange and cream), clean readable silhouettes, soft rim light from the lighthouse lamp, no text unless asked, no watermark.

assets.prompt: Key art for the game: night storm over a small rocky island with a tall red-and-white lighthouse whose lamp has just been relit, a beam sweeping the dark sea; on the pier in the foreground Miso, a small orange cat in a yellow raincoat, holds up a glowing lantern; two fishing boats with warm cabin lights head home through the waves.

assets.text: 暴风雨的夜里，灯塔的光熄灭了。小猫米索穿上黄色雨衣，提着油灯出发了——渔船们，还在等着回家。

assets.prompt: Pixel-art game trailer shot: the lighthouse beam sweeps across the stormy sea, rain falls, waves crash on the rocks, the little cat in a yellow raincoat raises her glowing lantern on the pier, the two fishing boats slowly sail toward the island. Keep the pixel-art look, slow cinematic push-in, rain and waves sound.
